description: Regionalizações - Polígono das Secas - 1:100.000 - vetor - 2014 - SEI is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Com intuito de aplicação de programas e projetos voltados ao desenvolvimento territorial, as diversas instâncias de governo criam, a partir de critérios específicos, agrupamentos de unidades administrativas (município, estados), criando as denominadas Regionalizações. São definidas por instrumento legal (lei, decreto, portaria) e são utilizadas como instrumentos do planejamento. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Município, Bahia, planningCadastre. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
